citations.excerpt: Agentic software development is driving the next architectural shift. With developers and agents working concurrently in repositories that receive millions of commits a day, these workloads demand a different Git architecture.

citations.label: GitHub Blog, Building Git infrastructure for agent-scale development
citations.excerpt: Commit turnaround becomes a bottleneck per agent. An agent in a tight loop commits or checkpoints after nearly every action. Its speed is bounded by how fast a single push completes, so latency that a human would never notice becomes the limiting factor.
